1. Trapezoid(A,B,C,D) & Parallel(A,B,C,D) & Length_A_D - Length_B_C => EquilateralTrapezoid(A,B,C,D)

3. -Length_B_G + Length_C_G & Length_C_G - Length_D_G => Angle_B_C_D - Angle_B_G_D/2
4. Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Angle_A_B_C + Angle_B_C_D - pi
5. Angle_A_B_C - Angle_B_A_D & Angle_B_C_D - Angle_B_G_D/2 & Angle_A_B_C + Angle_B_C_D - pi & Angle_B_A_D - 2*pi/3 & Angle_A_G_B + Angle_A_G_D - Angle_B_G_D => Angle_A_G_B + Angle_A_G_D - 2*pi/3
6. Length_C_G - Length_D_G => Angle_C_D_G - Angle_D_C_G
7. Angle_B_C_D - Angle_B_C_G + Angle_D_C_G & Angle_A_D_C - Angle_A_D_G + Angle_C_D_G & Angle_A_D_C - Angle_B_C_D & Angle_C_D_G - Angle_D_C_G => Angle_A_D_G - Angle_B_C_G
8. -Length_A_D + Length_B_C & Length_C_G - Length_D_G & -Angle_A_D_G + Angle_B_C_G => Congruent3(A,D,G,B,C,G)
9. Congruent3(A,D,G,B,C,G) => Angle_A_G_D - Angle_B_G_C
10. Angle_A_G_B + Angle_A_G_D - 2*pi/3 & Angle_A_G_B - Angle_A_G_C + Angle_B_G_C & Angle_A_G_D - Angle_B_G_C => Angle_A_G_C - 2*pi/3
